title: Cafeteria Manager's Bulletin: Voids and Purchase Disputes on the School Nutrition Services Meal Account
content:
**Cashier voids.** A cashier may void a purchase line on a School Nutrition Services Meal Account only on the day it was rung up, with the void reason cashier void.

**Dispute window.** A purchase may be disputed only within 30 days after the purchase is rung up (the purchase dispute days), counted in calendar days with the purchase date as day 0, and a dispute raised on the last day is still considered. The clock starts on the purchase line's service date in the point-of-sale record of that same line.

**When a dispute is upheld.** A dispute is upheld when the point-of-sale record shows a line the student was not served, a duplicate ring-up of the same meal, or a charge above the rate of the student's status on the service date; an upheld dispute reverses exactly the disputed line with the void reason dispute upheld, and a charge above the status rate is reversed with the void reason status correction.

**Declined disputes.** A line is reversed once; a dispute over a line already reversed, or over a charge that matches the status rate, is declined.

## Window boundary (hypothetical dates)

| Purchase rung up (day 0) | Dispute raised | Considered? |
|---|---|---|
| a Monday | the Wednesday 30 days later (day 30) | yes, the last day counts |
| a Monday | the Thursday 31 days later (day 31) | no |

## Outcome table

| Point-of-sale finding | Outcome | Void reason |
|---|---|---|
| line not served to the student | reversed | dispute upheld |
| duplicate ring-up of the same meal | reversed | dispute upheld |
| charge above the status rate on the service date | reversed | status correction |
| charge matches the status rate | declined | none |
| line already reversed | declined | none |
